title: Stronger Characteristic Searches for Fly and Pipo
summary: Restricted-mask searches found useful 8-round Fly and 5-round Pipo approximations but no useful longer ones; whether stronger searches can improve both estimates remains open.

formal_statement.body: Can stronger characteristic searches improve the reported linear-approximation estimates for Fly and Pipo?

scope.domain: Automated linear cryptanalysis of the Fly and Pipo block ciphers.
parameters: Round count—the number of cipher rounds covered by a searched linear approximation
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether stronger characteristic-search methods can improve the reported linear-approximation estimates for both Fly and Pipo.

citations.label: Quantum Linear Key-recovery Attacks Using the QFT

progress.summary: The source reports useful approximations for 8 rounds of Fly and 5 rounds of Pipo from a restricted-mask search, but none useful at greater lengths. A reported 6-round branch-and-bound characteristic motivates the conjecture that stronger searches could improve both estimates.
citation_labels: André Schrottenloher et al., Quantum Linear Key-recovery Attacks Using the QFT
